10000.description: Allows a guild to participate in the [War of Emperium](/wiki/War_of_Emperium.md) and [War of Emperium 2](/wiki/War_of_Emperium_2.md). Without this skill, you will not be able to hit the Emperium no matter how much [HIT](/wiki/Stats.md) your character has.

10002.description:
Study the technology of a Guardian. Through the research, the guild can hire Guardians for their territory.
See [Guardian NPCs](/wiki/War_of_Emperium.md) for more information.

10011.description:
All guild members visible on the Guild Leader's screen increase their HP and SP regeneration rate. Once used, caster must wait 5 minutes before using this skill again. Can only be used during guild sieges.

* Is on the same timer as [Restoration](/wiki/Restoration.md), [Battle Command](/wiki/Battle_Command.md) and [Urgent Call](/wiki/Urgent_Call.md).

| Level | Effects |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2x HP Regeneration |
| 2 | 2x HP and SP Regeneration |
| 3 | 3x HP and SP Regeneration |

10012.description:
All guild members visible on the Guild Master's screen will have their HP and SP restored to 90% of the respective maximum. Once used, caster must wait 5 minutes before using this skill again. Can only be used during guild [Siege](/wiki/Siege.md)s.

* The skill shares the same timer as [Regeneration](/wiki/Regeneration.md), [Battle Command](/wiki/Battle_Command.md), and [Urgent Call](/wiki/Urgent_Call.md).

10013.description:
All guild members will be teleported next to the Guild Master. Once used, the caster must wait 5 minutes before using this skill again.

* If a guild member is on a loading screen when the skill is cast, they will not be brought to the guild leader.
* Guild members who are dead (ex. If a party of guild members is dead in a dungeon for some reason) will also not be brought to the guild leader.
* The delay associated with this skill is the same delay that is associated with the skills [Restoration](/wiki/Restoration.md), [Regeneration](/wiki/Regeneration.md), and [Battle Command](/wiki/Battle_Command.md). If a guild leader preforms one of these, they cannot preform Urgent Call until the 5 minute delay has enlapsed, and vice versa.
* If the guild leader is a [TaeKwon Kid](/wiki/TaeKwon_Kid.md) or [TaeKwon Master](/wiki/TaeKwon_Master.md) class, once they put skill points into [Leap](/wiki/Leap.md), that leader's recall cast time is doubled (from 5 to 10 seconds).

10014.description: While investing, guilds with this skill have a 50% chance of getting an extra point for free. This only works with [commerce investment](/wiki/War_of_Emperium.md), and does not prevent a second invest for the day.

1005.description: Holds a foe interlocked with the caster without either side being able to move, but still being able to attack or use skills and items. Casting it beyond the range of 2 cells results in skill failure. When using this skill, player gains +10 [Flee](/wiki/Stats.md).

1006.description: For two minutes, you will be surrounded by the fires of [Sight](/wiki/Sight.md). While Sight Blaster is active, any enemy that steps in a 3x3 area around you will be thrown back and take a 100% [MATK](/wiki/Stats.md) [Fire](/wiki/Fire.md) hit. In [WoE](/wiki/War_of_Emperium.md), there is no knockback. Once the skill has hit a target, Sight Blaster ends. Hits multiple targets if they are all in range of skill when activated.

1007.description:
Creates an elemental converter. You can create an elemental converter of any of the 4 elements, [Fire](/wiki/Fire.md), [Earth](/wiki/Earth.md), [Wind](/wiki/Wind.md), and [Water](/wiki/Water.md). These converters can be used with the skill [Elemental Change](/wiki/Elemental_Change.md) or used on their own to endow yourself with an element for a short period or time. The success rate of creating an elemental converter is 100%.

| Water Elemental Converter | 3 Snail's Shells Blank Scroll |
| Earth Elemental Converter | 3 Horns Blank Scroll |
| Wind Elemental Converter | 3 Rainbow Shells Blank Scroll |

The success rate is based on your own level, and the [VIT](/wiki/Stats.md), level, and [LUK](/wiki/Stats.md) of the target. This affects players and monsters, but does not affect [boss monsters](/wiki/Boss_Protocol.md).

1013.description: When used, you automatically pick up all items within 2 cells around you. This does not override the priority of who gets to pick up the drops, and it cannot be used in [PvP](/wiki/PvP~d29d2.md), [WoE](/wiki/War_of_Emperium.md), or in [Town](/wiki/categories/Towns.md)s.

1014.description: Sacrifice yourself in order to revive all [Party](/wiki/Party.md) members near you. The skill will affect any [Party](/wiki/Party.md) member within a 15 * 15 area around you, and they will all be revived with 50% [HP](/wiki/Max_HP.md). When successful, this skill reduces your [HP](/wiki/Max_HP.md) and [SP](/wiki/SP.md) to 1, and you lose 1% of your Base [EXP](/wiki/Experience.md). For each person you revive with the skill however, the penalty is reduced by 0.2% exp. With 5 or more people, you do not suffer any [EXP](/wiki/Experience.md) penalty. If you do not have enough [EXP](/wiki/Experience.md) to cast this skill, it will fail.

25.description:
Creates a 3x3 cell cloud around the target cell that blocks the damage all ranged physical attacks. This means that it also blocks the bow attacks of players. Monsters (and player attacks/skills) count as being "ranged" if their attack has a range of 4 or more cells.

Pneuma cannot be cast if it is targeted to overlap an already existing Pneuma area, [Magnetic Earth](/wiki/Magnetic_Earth.md), or a [Safety Wall](/wiki/Safety_Wall.md). It can also be used to prevent a Safety Wall from being created on the target area. Note that **only** damage is blocked by Pneuma; other effects like [Stun](/wiki/Status_Effects.md) and knockback will retain their abilities. It is therefore possible to use [Arrow Repel](/wiki/Arrow_Repel.md) to knock a player out of a Pneuma and into harm's way.

After 10 seconds, Pneuma will expire. It will be difficult for you to recast pneuma on the same cell quickly, so it is simpler to place 2 pneumas side-by-side and shift when the time is up. The only delay is in the animation, so you can spawn many pneumas to protect many people at once. In a party, remember to pneuma yourself before doing so.

Unless the user also has the [Rogue](/wiki/Rogue.md) skill [Stalk](/wiki/Stalk.md), using hiding will render you stationary. You can't use items while Hiding.

The initial cast costs 10 SP, and the skill drains SP every set number of seconds according to the Hide level. Using the skill again will reveal yourself.

Pneuma.description:
Creates a 3x3 cell cloud around the target cell that blocks the damage all ranged physical attacks. This means that it also blocks the bow attacks of players. Monsters (and player attacks/skills) count as being "ranged" if their attack has a range of 4 or more cells.

Pneuma cannot be cast if it is targeted to overlap an already existing Pneuma area, [Magnetic Earth](/wiki/Magnetic_Earth.md), or a [Safety Wall](/wiki/Safety_Wall.md). It can also be used to prevent a Safety Wall from being created on the target area. Note that **only** damage is blocked by Pneuma; other effects like [Stun](/wiki/Status_Effects.md) and knockback will retain their abilities. It is therefore possible to use [Arrow Repel](/wiki/Arrow_Repel.md) to knock a player out of a Pneuma and into harm's way.

After 10 seconds, Pneuma will expire. It will be difficult for you to recast pneuma on the same cell quickly, so it is simpler to place 2 pneumas side-by-side and shift when the time is up. The only delay is in the animation, so you can spawn many pneumas to protect many people at once. In a party, remember to pneuma yourself before doing so.

Pneuma completely blocks the following skills:

*  [Acid Bomb](/wiki/Acid_Bomb.md)
*  [Acid Terror](/wiki/Acid_Terror.md)
*  [Arrow Shower](/wiki/Arrow_Shower.md)

Quagmire cannot reduce said stats of monsters by more than 50%, and those of players by more than 25%. In [PvP](/wiki/PvP~d29d2.md), Quagmire can cancel certain buff effects, skills such as [Increase AGI](/wiki/Increase_AGI.md), [Twohand Quicken](/wiki/Twohand_Quicken.md) and [Adrenaline Rush](/wiki/Adrenaline_Rush.md).
